detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Concrete one: an after-hours booking on CallNode, end to end.
1. Caller: "Anything Thursday afternoon?"
2. Your agent checks the calendar, offers two slots.
3. Caller picks one; agent confirms the name.
4. Webhook fires a booked event to your app; the SMS confirmation goes out before the hangup.
No phone tree, no voicemail. The calendar is fuller in the morning and nobody worked late. #VoiceAI #AIAgents
